name: Spider Behavioral State Machine
principle: Biological spider behaviors are translated into measurable, ethical business-system states. Analogies guide architecture; they are not literal biology claims.

premolt.system_behavior: reduce risky changes, increase checks, prepare snapshot and rollback

ecdysis.system_behavior: freeze nonessential mutations, isolate migration, verify integrity

postmolt.system_behavior: stabilize, observe health, delay further major mutations

defense.system_behavior: rate-limit, isolate, preserve evidence, keep safe services alive

escape.system_behavior: circuit-break, fail over where verified, preserve queue

thanatosis.system_behavior: stop nonessential outbound actions while sensing continues

autotomy.system_behavior: detach module without killing core organism

crypsis.system_behavior: minimize attack surface and unnecessary exposure; never deceive users

hunt.system_behavior: select web, ambush, pursuit, interception or observe strategy

orientation.system_behavior: combine source, intent, behavior and context into opportunity score

stalking.system_behavior: serve progressively relevant information without unsolicited contact

predatory_leap.system_behavior: surface immediate simulator, booking or explicit CTA

ambush.system_behavior: wait for strong intent then surface relevant offer

wrap.system_behavior: normalize, deduplicate and route lead safely

web_building.system_behavior: build durable useful content, tools and internal links

web_repair.system_behavior: repair, consolidate or retire weak assets; recycle learnings

ballooning.system_behavior: deploy portable DNA to a new tenant/channel/territory with isolation

rappelling.system_behavior: controlled rollback to last verified snapshot

aquatic_mode.system_behavior: use adapter layer while preserving core contracts

courtship.system_behavior: clear identity, consent and value exchange

wandering.system_behavior: explore new organic niches and signals with bounded experiments

pheromone_detection.system_behavior: detect aggregate demand indicators without sensitive-person inference

drumming.system_behavior: use transparent micro-interactions/questions to distinguish needs

egg_guarding.system_behavior: verify checksum, redundancy, restore path and access separation

offspring_transport.system_behavior: carry only structural DNA/templates, never another tenant's customer data

maternal_care.system_behavior: stricter defaults, observation and human review until enough evidence

social_cooperation.system_behavior: coordinate through explicit contracts and shared audit trail

gregarious_tolerance.system_behavior: coexist with hard logical isolation and quotas

diapause.system_behavior: reduce experiments/cost while preserving sensing and health

fasting.system_behavior: survive without inventing conclusions; preserve state and run bounded exploration

regeneration.system_behavior: rebuild from DNA, schema, snapshots and provider-neutral contracts

selection_rule: State transitions must be driven by observable signals and policy. No dark patterns, fake scarcity, spam, covert manipulation, automatic consequential contact, or cross-tenant customer-data inheritance.
